cleaner.label: Aider
cleaner.description: Cache and factory-wipe cleaners for Aider

option.label: Cache
option.description: Delete Aider caches, logs, and temporary files.
option.warning: Close Aider before cleaning. This preserves config and OAuth/API-key files.

option.label: Factory wipe
option.warning: This removes Aider config, analytics state, OAuth/API-key files, installs data, logs, and caches.
